## Research focus

This work examines how data science has changed using evidence from U.S. job postings spanning 2010–2025. I am a co-author with H. Zhang, J. M. Rosenberg, and C. Sublett.

## Manuscript citation

Zhang, H., Rosenberg, J. M., Wang, W., & Sublett, C. (under revision, 2026). How data science has changed: Evidence from U.S. job postings, 2010–2025. *Harvard Data Science Review*.
